title: Some Smile
body:
# **_SOME SMILE RESOURCE-PACK_**
## Add some Smiles to your life!
Of course, no sadness!
### What does this resource pack provide?
> This resource pack adds smiles to many _**GUI**_ textures, _such as chest, book, furnace, dispenser, and other backgrounds!_ Button backgrounds and heart replacements!

![Replacement of Hearts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a94a1b7f4e26d1801df13f1b3e202972fdf979f.png)

Use this resource pack to your heart's content and wish everyone happiness, because this is the only way you can play on Minecraft servers without ~~Aggression!~~

## All Versions are supported, other Textures are under development! :))

**This resource pack died a long time ago, and now I'm barely even trying to piece it back together. This resource pack used to have a "local" community and was even actively updated, adding new "smiles" each time, but then, one day, it all disappeared.**

**_After a while, I decided to bring it back and try uploading it to various platforms!_**

Have questions about the Resource Pack or other services? Contact us at [OUR WEBSITE](https://bereza.netlify.app/)
